title: Web3 is dead? Why crypto developers are pivoting to AI

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Web3 isn't dead—it's evolving, with blockchain enabling decentralized AI governance and trustless collaboration.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Crypto's hype cycle collapsed. AI offers real utility, while blockchain remains speculative, with no killer app.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Ethereum's Layer 2s and ZK-Rollups are scaling Web3, enabling decentralized AI training and data marketplaces.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Developers are leaving blockchain for AI because it delivers measurable impact, not just token inflation and hype.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Web3 is a dead-end; AI is the future, with tangible applications in healthcare, finance, and autonomous systems.
